# 37 - The Math Puzzle

> A free math puzzle game for iOS, Android and web browsers. Across every mode you are dealt
> seven dice and must build one equation that equals exactly 37, using all seven dice and the
> order of operations. Each of the three game modes - Easy, Challenge and Expert - has its own
> Daily Challenge, so there are three shared puzzles each day, the way Wordle works. Every mode also has an untimed
> Practice version, and Blitz Colosseum adds speed rounds and 1-v-1 battles, alongside a friends
> list, streaks, badges, Puzzle Pieces and leaderboards.

Publisher: HiiPointe Games LLC
Website: https://www.37themathpuzzle.com/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/37-the-math-puzzle/id6762534650
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hiipointegames.themathpuzzle37
Price: Free to download and play, ad supported. No subscription required.
Content rating: Rated 13+ on the App Store and Google Play. Under-13s should play
  with a parent or teacher rather than independently.

## How the puzzle works

Each Daily Challenge deals 7 dice: 4 white dice and 3 coloured Power Dice.
Every die must be used exactly once. Allowed operations are addition, subtraction,
multiplication, division, exponents and parentheses. The expression must evaluate to
exactly 37 under the standard order of operations (PEMDAS).

Power Dice rules:
- Green die must appear in an addition or a subtraction.
- Blue die must appear in a multiplication or a division.
- Red die must be used as an exponent, either the base or the power.

Using at least 2 of the 3 Power Dice correctly is a win. Using all 3 correctly is a
Perfect Solve, which earns a Puzzle Piece.

## Worked examples

Winning Solve. Dice rolled: 3, 4, 2, 2 white; 3 blue; 5 red; 5 green.
Equation: (5 + 3) x 3 + (4 + 2) + 2 + 5 = 37
Order of operations: 5 + 3 = 8, 8 x 3 = 24, 4 + 2 = 6, 24 + 6 = 30, 30 + 2 = 32, 32 + 5 = 37.

Perfect Solve. Dice rolled: 2, 4, 4, 6 white; 6 blue; 2 red; 1 green.
Equation: 2^2 + 4 x 6 + 4 + 6 - 1 = 37
Order of operations: 2^2 = 4, 4 x 6 = 24, 4 + 24 = 28, 28 + 4 = 32, 32 + 6 = 38, 38 - 1 = 37.

## Game modes

There are three game modes. Each has its own timed Daily Challenge and its own untimed
Practice version with unlimited rolls.

- Easy: seven white dice, no Power Dice rules. Any equation using all seven that equals 37 wins.
- Challenge: four white dice plus three Power Dice. At least two of the three must be placed
  correctly (a Valid Solve). Using all three also wins and earns a Puzzle Piece.
- Expert: the same setup as Challenge, but all three Power Dice must be placed correctly
  (a Perfect Solve). This is the mode the weekly $37 prize draw runs on.

Each day the game rolls three separate sets of seven dice, one per mode, so the Easy Daily,
Challenge Daily and Expert Daily are three different puzzles. Each Daily allows up to one hour,
cannot be paused, and posts to that mode's own podium and Global Leaderboard. Each mode keeps
its own daily streak. Leaving the gameplay screen forfeits only that Daily, not the other two.

Blitz Colosseum sits alongside the three modes: Solo Blitz races your own previous best times in
rounds from one to ten minutes, and Blitz Battle is 1-v-1 against a friend.

## Who it is for

All ages. Kids who are learning math can start in Easy, which has no Power Dice rules, and its
Practice version has no
timer, and move up to the full Daily Challenge as they gain confidence. Also played by students,
homeschoolers, teachers, adult puzzlers and older players who want daily mental arithmetic
practice. Free to play with no subscription, no paywall and no credit card required.
Frequently compared to Wordle, Nerdle and Mathler.

## Quick facts

Price: Free, ad supported. No subscription, no paywall, no in-app purchases.
Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets, and any modern web browser.
Goal: Build one equation that equals exactly 37.
Dice per puzzle: Seven, each used exactly once.
Operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, exponents, parentheses.
Modes: Easy, Challenge and Expert, each with a timed Daily Challenge and an untimed Practice
  version, plus Blitz Colosseum.
Multiplayer: Battle Friends head to head, and 1-v-1 Blitz Battle.
Progress: streaks, badges, Puzzle Pieces, personal stats, daily podium, Global Leaderboard.
Typical session: a few minutes; Solo Blitz rounds run from one to ten minutes.
Content rating: Rated 13+ on both stores.
Made by: HiiPointe Games LLC, Kansas City.

## Glossary

Daily Challenge - the timed shared puzzle; every player worldwide gets the same roll each day.
Power Dice - the three coloured dice (green additive, blue multiplicative, red exponent).
Valid Solve - reaches 37 using all seven dice with at least two Power Dice used correctly.
Perfect Solve - reaches 37 with all three Power Dice used correctly; earns a Puzzle Piece.
Puzzle Piece - the collectable reward for a Perfect Solve.
Easy - seven white dice, no Power Dice rules.
Challenge - four white dice plus three Power Dice, at least two placed correctly.
Expert - the same setup as Challenge, but all three Power Dice must be placed correctly.
Practice - the untimed version of any mode, unlimited rolls, does not post to leaderboards.
Blitz Colosseum - the speed area containing Solo Blitz and Blitz Battle.
Solo Blitz - single-player speed rounds from one to ten minutes against your own best times.
Blitz Battle - a 1-v-1 speed race against a friend.
Battle Friends - head-to-head play against a friend you have added.
Podium - the daily top three fastest solve times in the Daily Challenge.
